name: skillvault-install
title: SkillVault Install
description: Install or update catalog skills in a chosen scope; overlaps with skillvault-upsert on installation, but does not author source skills.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: skillOrFolderOrKeyword
inputs.description: Name, folder, or keyword used to install or update catalog skills. Omit to explore; use update to refresh approved managed installed copies.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Optional second positional target: global (~/.copilot/skills), project (.github/skills), or session (current AI session only). Defaults to the resolved skill's install.defaultScope, then project.

inputs.name: version
inputs.description: Optional third positional version: latest or a tag in v#.#.# format. Defaults to latest.
